description: This file defines the 'CategoryDao' interface, which declares data access methods for the 'Category' entity in a shopping system. It includes methods for retrieving categories by various attributes such as store, URL, lineage, name, code, ID, depth, parent, and language, as well as counting associated products.

classes.name: CategoryDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to 'Category' objects within the system.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories associated with a specific store and SEO URL.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories within a store that have a specific parent category.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Returns categories based on store and lineage string.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Fetches a category from a store by its name and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by store and category code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories for a given store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories for a store filtered by language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its unique identifier.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories within a store at a specific depth level.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth within a store, filtered by language.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories by store code and lineage.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Gets a category by store code and category code.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a category by store and SEO URL.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories with a specific parent and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Fetches a category by its ID and language.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts products associated with a list of category IDs within a store.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories by store, a list of codes, and language.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by store, list of IDs, and language.
